claims.statement: Management aspires to achieve operating margins in the 16% to 17% range.
claims.quote: we want to be in the 16 to 17 % range, that is our aspiration. That will be our endeavour
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Management expects regulatory approvals for the Nagarro acquisition within 4 to 6 weeks, or a maximum of 8 weeks.
claims.quote: We expect in the next 4 to 6 weeks, max, let's say 8 weeks, that's our hope and expectation.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Management estimates needing 5 to 6 months to bring the two companies together after deal closure.
claims.quote: we will need about 5 to 6 months to optimistically bring the 2 companies together.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Management states that acquisition-related costs of 19 to 20 million are incurred in Q2 and another 25 to 30 million will be incurred over the next 3 to 4 quarters.
claims.quote: Right now, around 19 to 20 million is what basically is incurred in Q2. And as I said, 25 to 30 million will be incurred over the next 3 to 4 quarters.
claims.speaker: management
